# PURL test suite

These JSON files are copied unchanged from the official Package-URL specification test suite at tag `v1.1.0`:
https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec/tree/v1.1.0/tests

- `spec/specification-test.json` covers the core specification.
- `types/*-test.json` covers each registered PURL type.
